Plague Doctor: As a bonus action, coat a weapon in plague for 1 minute. A creature you hit makes a Constitution save or becomes infected, taking 1d6 poison damage at the start of its turns, repeating the save each turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
You gain proficiency with the herbalism kit and the poisoner's kit. If you already have one of these proficiencies, you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain artificer levels, as follows (artificer level: spells). 3rd level: detect poison and disease and inflict wounds. 5th level: protection from poison and ray of enfeeblement. 9th level: stinking cloud and bestow curse. 13th level: blight and death ward. 17th level: contagion and cloudkill. They count as artificer spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.
You gain resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against disease. Once per turn, when you hit an infected creature with a weapon or spell, it takes an extra 1d8 poison damage.
Once per turn, when an infected creature ends its turn or drops to 0 hit points, you can spread the infection to another creature within 10 feet of it, which makes the Constitution save to resist.

As an action, release a 20-foot-radius cloud of sickness within 60 feet for 1 minute. Creatures of your choice starting their turn inside make a Constitution save or become infected and take 4d6 poison damage. Once per long rest.
Warchanter: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons, and with war drums and war horns. A war drum or war horn counts as a musical instrument for your Bard features and can be your spellcasting focus.

As a bonus action, expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to begin a war chant for 1 minute. Allies within 30 feet who can hear you add 1d4 to weapon damage rolls and have advantage on saves against being frightened.

You can attack twice when you take the Attack action. While you chant, an ally within 30 feet who reduces a creature to 0 hit points can use its reaction to move half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Your chant carries further and drives the march. While you chant, its range becomes 60 feet, and you and allies in range have +10 feet of speed. Once per short or long rest, you can begin Battle Hymn without expending Bardic Inspiration.

While you chant, allies within 30 feet deal an extra 1d6 thunder damage on their first weapon hit each turn. As a reaction when one is hit, grant it 2d8 temporary hit points, Charisma modifier times per long rest.
Gravecaller: You learn spare the dying. When a creature you can see within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, use your reaction to let an ally within 30 feet of it regain 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier hit points. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain cleric levels, as follows (cleric level: spells). 3rd level: false life, sanctuary, gentle repose and ray of enfeeblement. 5th level: speak with dead and vampiric touch. 7th level: blight and death ward. 9th level: antilife shell and raise dead. They count as cleric spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.

As an action, choose a creature within 30 feet. A dying ally stabilizes and regains 2d8 hit points, or a hostile creature makes a Charisma save or takes 2d8 necrotic damage and has its speed halved until your next turn.

Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage to it, and it cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

You and allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saving throws. Once per long rest, as a reaction when an ally within 60 feet dies, you return it to life with 4d8 hit points before its soul departs.
Rune Priest: As a bonus action, inscribe a rune on an ally within 30 feet for 1 minute. A ward rune grants 1d6 temporary hit points each turn; a smite rune adds 1d6 radiant damage to weapon hits. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain cleric levels, as follows (cleric level: spells). 3rd level: alarm, shield of faith, arcane lock and magic weapon. 5th level: glyph of warding and protection from energy. 7th level: guardian of faith and stone shape. 9th level: hallow and wall of force. They count as cleric spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.

As an action, carve a trigger rune on a surface within 30 feet. The first hostile creature to enter its square makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 radiant damage and being restrained until its next turn on a failure, or half on a success.

You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip. When a cantrip of yours damages a creature that is within 10 feet of one of your runes, it also takes 1d4 extra radiant damage.
You can maintain up to three runes at once, and your Sacred Inscription runes last 1 hour. When one of your runes triggers or ends, each ally within 10 feet of it regains 2d8 hit points.
Storm Caller: You learn shocking grasp and always have thunderwave prepared. As a bonus action, expend a use of Wild Shape to wreathe yourself in storm for 1 minute; creatures that hit you with melee attacks take 1d8 lightning damage.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain druid levels, as follows (druid level: spells). 3rd level: feather fall, fog cloud, gust of wind and shatter. 5th level: call lightning and lightning bolt. 7th level: conjure minor elementals and ice storm. 9th level: cone of cold and conjure elemental. They count as druid spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.
While your Tempest Mantle is active, you have a flying speed of 30 feet. When you deal lightning or thunder damage with a spell, you can push one target up to 10 feet away from you.
You gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. Once per turn, when you deal lightning damage with a spell, one other creature within 10 feet of the target takes 1d8 thunder damage.

As an action, call a storm in a 30-foot radius within 120 feet for 1 minute. As a bonus action on each of your turns, strike one creature inside for 3d10 lightning damage, Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.
Wilderness Oracle: After a long rest, roll two d20s and record them as omens. Once per turn, you can replace an attack roll, saving throw or ability check made by you or a creature you can see with an omen, before the roll.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain druid levels, as follows (druid level: spells). 3rd level: detect magic, speak with animals, augury and locate animals or plants. 5th level: clairvoyance and plant growth. 7th level: divination and locate creature. 9th level: commune with nature and scrying. They count as druid spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.
You can cast speak with animals and speak with plants without spell slots. Beasts and plants nearby warn you of danger: you cannot be surprised, and you add your Wisdom modifier to initiative rolls.
As a reaction when you or an ally within 30 feet makes an attack roll or saving throw, you can add or subtract 1d6 from the result after seeing it. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.
You roll three d20s for Omens in the Fog instead of two. Once per long rest, you can cast foresight on a creature without expending a spell slot, lasting 1 hour.
Abyssal Knight: As a bonus action, ignite your weapon with abyssal flame for 1 minute. Your weapon hits deal an extra 1d6 fire damage, and once per turn a hit grants you temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

You gain proficiency in Intimidation, or in Deception if you are already proficient. While your Abyssal Brand burns, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks made against creatures that can see you.
You gain resistance to fire damage and advantage on saves against being frightened. You can speak, read and write Abyssal, and you add your Constitution modifier to Charisma (Intimidation) checks.
When a creature within 30 feet damages you, you can use your reaction to mark it. Your next hit against it before the end of your next turn deals an extra 2d6 fire damage. Three uses per long rest.

Once per turn when you hit, the target makes a Constitution save (DC 8 plus your proficiency bonus and Constitution modifier) or is poisoned until the end of its next turn. Celestials have disadvantage on this save.
Once per turn, when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you regain 2d8 plus your Constitution modifier hit points. While your Abyssal Brand burns, you have resistance to necrotic damage.
Deathblade: As a bonus action, study a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. You learn its damage vulnerabilities, resistances and immunities, and your first weapon hit against it each turn deals an extra 1d8 damage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
You gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit and in your choice of Insight or Investigation. By spending 1 minute examining a corpse, you learn how the creature died and roughly how long ago.
You gain proficiency in Medicine, or expertise if already proficient. When you score a critical hit, the target makes a Constitution save or its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 against a creature you are studying with Killing Eye, and the critical hit adds one extra weapon damage die.

Once per short rest, when you hit a creature, declare a death blow. It makes a Constitution save, taking an extra 6d8 necrotic damage and being unable to regain hit points until your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.
Killing Eye lasts until you dismiss it and its extra damage becomes 2d8. Once per turn, you can apply Killing Eye to a creature below half its hit points without expending a use.
Hex Knight: As a bonus action, hex a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. Your weapon hits against it deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability you choose. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
You learn your choice of the minor illusion or thaumaturgy cantrip, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it. You also gain proficiency in Arcana or Religion, your choice.
You have advantage on saves against curses. When a hexed creature within 30 feet attacks you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the roll. Constitution modifier uses per long rest.
Once per turn, when you hit a hexed creature, you gain 1d6 temporary hit points. If a hexed creature drops to 0 hit points, you can move the hex to another creature within 30 feet without an action.

A hexed creature takes 1d8 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns and cannot take reactions against you. It makes a Wisdom save at the end of each turn, ending these extra effects on a success.
You can keep your hex on two creatures at once. Once per long rest, as an action, you can hex every creature of your choice within 30 feet; each makes a Wisdom save to resist.
Elemental Fist: Your unarmed strikes can deal fire, cold, lightning or thunder damage. Once per turn, you can spend 1 ki point to add 1d6 damage of that type to a hit and give the strike 10 feet of extra reach.

As a reaction when you take fire, cold, lightning or thunder damage, you can spend 1 ki point to gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn, including against the triggering damage.
When you hit with an unarmed strike, you can spend 2 ki points to burst: the target and each creature within 5 feet of it take 2d8 damage of your chosen element, Dexterity save for half.
As a bonus action, spend 4 ki points to wreathe yourself in an element for 1 minute. Your speed increases by 20 feet, your unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d8 damage of that element, and you resist it.
Iron Fist: Your unarmed strikes count as magical. As a reaction when you take bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, you can spend 1 ki point to reduce it by 1d10 plus your Wisdom modifier.
Your unarmed strike damage die increases by one size. Once per turn when you hit, you can spend 1 ki point to push the target 10 feet or knock it prone, Strength save negates.
You gain resistance to fire damage. When you use Patient Defense, you also regain hit points equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.
You have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. Once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead.
Sand Dancer: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can kick up sand: one creature you hit makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the start of your next turn. Sand, dust and loose earth do not slow you.
When you use Step of the Wind, attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn, and the spaces you passed through are lightly obscured by drifting dust until then.

As a bonus action, spend 2 ki points to turn the ground in a 15-foot radius around you into loose sand for 1 minute. It is difficult terrain for others, who make a Strength save or fall prone when entering.

As an action, spend 5 ki points to become a whirling storm for 1 minute. Creatures within 10 feet of you at the start of your turn take 2d8 slashing damage and make a Constitution save or are blinded until their next turn.
Oathbreaker Knight: As a bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet that has not seen you attack. For 1 minute, your first hit against it each turn deals an extra 2d6 necrotic damage, and you have advantage on Deception checks against it.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain paladin levels, as follows (paladin level: spells). 3rd level: charm person and disguise self. 5th level: darkness and suggestion. 9th level: bestow curse and fear. 13th level: confusion and dominate beast. 17th level: dominate person and seeming. They count as paladin spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.
Hostile creatures within 10 feet of you subtract 1d4 from saves against being charmed or frightened, and you and allies in the aura cannot be charmed. The aura grows to 30 feet at 18th level.

When you take damage, you can use your reaction to break a piece of your old vow: gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn and deal 2d8 necrotic damage to the attacker. Twice per long rest.

Once per long rest, as an action, gain these benefits for 1 minute: you score critical hits on a 19 or 20, your hits deal an extra 2d8 necrotic damage, and creatures within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or are frightened.
Thornwalker: As a bonus action, sprout thorns for 1 minute. A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d6 piercing damage, and once per turn your weapon hits deal an extra 1d6 piercing damage. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

You always have certain spells prepared once you reach certain ranger levels, as follows (ranger level: spells). 3rd level: entangle and goodberry. 5th level: barkskin and protection from poison. 9th level: plant growth and protection from energy. 13th level: blight and freedom of movement. 17th level: insect plague and tree stride. They count as ranger spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you prepare.

When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, thorny vines grasp it: it makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or is restrained until the end of its next turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

You can cast spike growth without a spell slot once per short rest, and you and your allies ignore its damage and difficult terrain. Creatures restrained by your thorns take 1d8 piercing damage at the start of their turns.
You gain +1 AC while Briar Skin is active. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to lash a creature within 15 feet with thorns, dealing 2d8 piercing damage.
Blood Dancer: Once per turn when you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can lose 5 hit points to add 2d6 necrotic damage. As a bonus action, you can lose 5 hit points to move 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
You gain proficiency in Medicine. As an action, you can taste a drop of a creature's fresh blood to learn its creature type and whether it is poisoned, diseased or under a curse.

As an action, lose 5 hit points to lash blood at a creature within 30 feet. It makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 necrotic damage and being restrained until the end of its next turn on a failure, or half on a success.

When a creature within 15 feet damages you, you can use your reaction to spray it with blood, dealing 2d8 necrotic damage and giving it disadvantage on its next attack roll. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
You have resistance to necrotic damage. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with Sneak Attack, you regain the hit points you lost to your features this turn plus 2d8.
Chaos Shaper: When you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, you can spend 1 sorcery point and roll a d4: 1 push a target 10 feet, 2 gain 1d8 temporary hit points, 3 add 1d6 force damage, 4 teleport 15 feet.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain sorcerer levels, as follows (sorcerer level: spells). 3rd level: color spray, grease, blur and mirror image. 5th level: blink and hypnotic pattern. 7th level: confusion and polymorph. 9th level: animate objects and mislead. They count as sorcerer spells for you but do not count against your number of spells known.
As a reaction when a creature within 60 feet makes a d20 roll, you can spend 2 sorcery points to force a reroll, and it must use the new result. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
Once per turn, when you roll damage for a spell, you can roll a d20. On 11 or higher, reroll the damage and keep the higher total; on 10 or lower, you take 1d8 force damage.

Once per long rest, as a bonus action, enter a chaos surge for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns, roll a d4: +2 spell save DC, +20 feet speed, 2d8 temporary hit points, or regain 2 sorcery points.
Dragonblood: Choose a dragon ancestor and its damage type. Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per sorcerer level, while unarmored your AC increases by 1 as scales spread over your skin, and you can speak, read and write Draconic.

You gain proficiency in your choice of History or Intimidation. By touching an object for 1 minute, you learn whether it contains gold, silver, gems or other precious materials, and roughly what it is worth.
When you cast a spell that deals your ancestry's damage type, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll. You can also spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that type for 1 hour.
As a bonus action, sprout dragon wings from your back and gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed until you dismiss them. You cannot use them while wearing armor not made for them.

As an action, spend 5 sorcery points to radiate dread or awe in a 60-foot radius for 1 minute while you concentrate. Hostile creatures starting their turn there make a Wisdom save or are charmed or frightened, your choice, until it ends.
Gnome Bloodline: The ground reports to you: you gain tremorsense out to 30 feet. You learn mold earth, and once per turn you can spend 1 sorcery point to add 1d8 bludgeoning damage to a spell that deals damage.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain sorcerer levels, as follows (sorcerer level: spells). 3rd level: longstrider, shield, locate object and spider climb. 5th level: meld into stone and protection from energy. 7th level: stone shape and stoneskin. 9th level: passwall and wall of stone. They count as sorcerer spells for you but do not count against your number of spells known.

Your skin hardens toward iron or diamond. While unarmored your AC increases by 1, and as a reaction you can reduce bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage by 1d10 plus your Charisma modifier. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

Your tremorsense extends to 60 feet. While touching the ground, you cannot be knocked prone or moved against your will, and you can spend 3 sorcery points as an action to turn a 20-foot radius within 60 feet into difficult terrain.
You gain resistance to bludgeoning damage. As a reaction when hit by an attack, raise a slab of stone to gain +2 AC against it, possibly causing a miss. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
Ignis Bloodline: You learn fire bolt. When you cast a spell that deals fire damage, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll. You have resistance to fire damage from any source other than your own spells, which cannot harm you.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain sorcerer levels, as follows (sorcerer level: spells). 3rd level: burning hands, shield, heat metal and scorching ray. 5th level: daylight and fireball. 7th level: fire shield and wall of fire. 9th level: conjure elemental and flame strike. They count as sorcerer spells for you but do not count against your number of spells known.

A constant warmth surrounds you within 10 feet: nonmagical ice and frost melt, allies have advantage on saves against extreme cold, and a creature that starts its turn grappling you takes 1d8 fire damage.

Your fire spells ignore resistance to fire damage. When a creature fails a save against your fire spell, it ignites, taking 1d8 fire damage at the start of its turns until it uses an action to put out the flames.

You gain immunity to fire damage. Once per turn, when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a fire spell, flames leap to another creature within 20 feet, dealing 2d8 fire damage, Dexterity save for half.
Mirror Mage: When a creature you can see targets you with an attack or spell, you can use your reaction and spend 1 sorcery point to gain +2 AC and advantage on saves against that attack or spell.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain sorcerer levels, as follows (sorcerer level: spells). 3rd level: shield, silent image, blur and mirror image. 5th level: counterspell and major image. 7th level: dimension door and greater invisibility. 9th level: mislead and seeming. They count as sorcerer spells for you but do not count against your number of spells known.

When you cast a spell that targets only one creature, you can spend sorcery points equal to the spell's level (1 for a cantrip) to have a reflection of it target a second creature within 30 feet of the first.

When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell, you can use your reaction to reflect it: its caster makes the same save against your spell save DC or suffers the spell's effect. Once per short rest.

When you see a creature cast a spell of 3rd level or lower, you can use your reaction to copy it, storing it for 1 hour. You can cast it once without a slot, using your spellcasting ability. Once per long rest.
Sylph Bloodline: You can fall as slowly as you wish and take no damage from falling. You learn gust, and once per turn when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can push one target 10 feet.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain sorcerer levels, as follows (sorcerer level: spells). 3rd level: feather fall, fog cloud, gust of wind and levitate. 5th level: fly and wind wall. 7th level: conjure minor elementals and freedom of movement. 9th level: conjure elemental and telekinesis. They count as sorcerer spells for you but do not count against your number of spells known.

After a long rest, choose a wind child: north grants cold resistance, south fire resistance, east lightning resistance, west +10 feet speed. You can spend 1 sorcery point to add 1d8 thunder damage to a spell.

You gain a flying speed of 30 feet. As a reaction when a creature within 60 feet moves, you can spend 2 sorcery points to force a Strength save; on a failure you move it up to 15 feet in a direction you choose.

As an action, spend 5 sorcery points to blow a 60-foot cone of storm wind. Creatures in it make a Strength save, taking 4d8 thunder damage and being pushed 20 feet on a failure, or half damage on a success.
Undine Bloodline: You can breathe water, see clearly underwater, and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you or an ally within 30 feet regains 1d4 plus your Charisma modifier hit points.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain sorcerer levels, as follows (sorcerer level: spells). 3rd level: cure wounds, fog cloud, lesser restoration and misty step. 5th level: water breathing and water walk. 7th level: control water and ice storm. 9th level: cone of cold and conjure elemental. They count as sorcerer spells for you but do not count against your number of spells known.

A thin layer of ice covers your skin. While unarmored your AC increases by 1, and when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d8 cold damage to it. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can spend 1 sorcery point to add a current to one target: push or pull it 15 feet or knock it prone, Strength save negates.

As an action, spend 4 sorcery points to release a wave in a 20-foot radius within 60 feet. Allies there regain 3d8 hit points; hostile creatures make a Strength save or take 3d8 bludgeoning damage and fall prone.
Diamond's Patron: Your patron's shard lets you harden to true diamond for an instant. As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you take no damage from it. Once per short rest.

As a bonus action, flash light off your skin. Creatures of your choice within 10 feet make a Constitution save or are blinded until the end of your next turn. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.
You gain resistance to radiant damage. When you are hit by an attack, roll a d6; on a 6, a shard breaks from your skin and the attack's damage is halved.
Once per turn, when you hit with eldritch blast or deal damage with a warlock spell, light refracts through you and one other creature within 15 feet of the target takes 2d8 radiant damage.
Iron's Patron: As a bonus action, reshape your weapon's edge. Tough form grants you +1 AC while you wield it. Sharp form adds 1d6 damage to its hits, but a natural 1 on an attack dulls it until you reshape it.
You do not need to eat or drink and have advantage on saves against disease and poison. Once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

As an action, bind a creature within 60 feet in iron chains. It makes a Strength save or is restrained for 1 minute, taking 1d8 force damage at the start of its turns and repeating the save each turn. Once per short rest.
Your hit point maximum increases by your warlock level. Once per turn when you hit with eldritch blast, you can push the target 10 feet or deal an extra 1d8 fire damage.
Void Caller: As a bonus action, open a pocket of void on a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your spells deal it an extra 1d6 force damage, and it cannot regain hit points above half its maximum. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
You gain resistance to force damage. As a bonus action, you can step through nothing and teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.
As a reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell of 2nd level or lower, you can unmake it, and the spell fails. Once per short rest.
As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or vanishes into the void until the end of your next turn, then returns taking 6d8 force damage. Once per long rest.
Astromancer: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, choose a star: Comet adds 1d6 radiant damage to one target, Moon heals a creature within 30 feet for 1d6, or Pole Star adds 2 to a concentration save. Intelligence modifier uses per long rest.

You gain proficiency with navigator's tools. While you can see the night sky, you always know which way is north and the time until sunrise, and you can never become lost when travelling by the stars.

Once per short rest, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, call a falling star on a point within 120 feet. Creatures in a 10-foot radius make a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 radiant damage or half on a success.
A tiny star orbits you. As a reaction when you or an ally within 30 feet is hit, reduce the damage by 2d10 plus your Intelligence modifier. Once per short rest.

As an action, crush a 15-foot radius within 120 feet with stellar gravity. Creatures there make a Strength save, taking 5d10 force damage and falling prone on a failure, or half on a success. Once per long rest.
